description: Call any REGISTERED tool by name — the dispatcher that makes a trimmed surface usable. find_tool discovers a name, inspect_tool shows its schema. Reaches only tools this session registered; for anything else use enable_toolset. Refuses to call itself.

arguments.description: Arguments for that tool, exactly as its own schema declares them

name.description: Exact registered tool name (find_tool discovers it; inspect_tool shows its schema)

name: call_tool
